name: What is the typical timeline for ADU construction from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for ADU construction from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical timeline for ADU construction, from design to completion, can range from 8 to 18 months. This includes several phases: initial design and architectural drawings (2-4 months), permit submission and approval (3-6 months, can vary greatly by jurisdiction), and actual construction (3-8 months). External factors like material availability, weather, and inspection schedules can also influence the overall duration. An experienced contractor can provide a more precise project schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: ADU construction typically takes 8-18 months, covering design, permitting, and construction phases. Permitting times can vary significantly.
